note: Trigger-accuracy regression suite. Same shape and run command as ../../recording-decisions/evals/README.md.

evals.name: review-pr-with-the-kb
evals.prompt: review this PR with the kb — branch is feat/tenant-cache, base is main. i want to know whether the records actually hold up against the code.
evals.why: The plain request, both halves of the range given.

evals.name: kb-aware-review
evals.prompt: do a kb-aware review of main..HEAD in this worktree
evals.why: The short form.

evals.name: check-the-claims
evals.prompt: the companion base on this branch claims a mitigation exists in PaymentClient.charge. can you check the claims in .strauss/kb against what the diff actually does?
evals.why: Checking base claims against code is the whole job.

evals.name: does-the-record-lie
evals.prompt: decision.tenant-cache-ttl says the cache is invalidated on write. read the anchor and tell me if that's true, and do the same for every other record on this diff.
evals.why: Per-record anchor reading across a diff.

evals.name: persuasion-risk
evals.prompt: i'm worried the kb records are talking the reviewer out of real findings — same model wrote both. is there a way to review the diff without the base first and then compare?
evals.why: The two-pass rationale, stated by the user.

evals.name: run-the-verify-commands
evals.prompt: before i merge, run the verify command on every record anchored in this diff and tell me which ones fail
evals.why: Verify-command execution is pass 2.

evals.name: rejected-alternative-real
evals.prompt: half these decisions list a rejected alternative that reads like it was invented to justify the choice. can you go through the ones on this PR and say which rejections are real?
evals.why: The convenient-alternative check.

evals.name: verdicts-per-record
evals.prompt: give me a verdict per record on this branch — verified, disputed or not checkable — so i can put it next to the hunks in the walkthrough
evals.why: The output shape, asked for by name.

evals.name: reviewer-actor
evals.prompt: i want an agent to review this diff against .strauss/kb and write its own risks back under agent:reviewer, not under the author
evals.why: The actor rule plus write-back.

evals.name: casual-do-the-records-hold
evals.prompt: do the records on this diff hold?
evals.why: Casual phrasing, still unambiguously this.

evals.name: plain-code-review
evals.prompt: review this diff for bugs and tell me what's wrong with the retry logic
evals.why: A plain code review with no base in play.

evals.name: write-the-records
evals.prompt: i just pushed commit 4 on this PR — which risks and flows should i put in .strauss/kb so the reviewer sees them?
evals.why: Writing the base is review-companion.

evals.name: record-a-decision
evals.prompt: i picked a heap over a sorted array for the top-k. is that worth a kb_write_decision, and what goes in it?
evals.why: recording-decisions.

evals.name: read-the-base
evals.prompt: what did we decide about the repository retry policy? check the knowledge base.
evals.why: Reading the base; the knowledge-base skill.

evals.name: review-paths-ingest
evals.prompt: build the acceptance-criteria review paths for compound c-12 and call strauss_ingest_review_paths
evals.why: review-path-planner, a different consumer of the same diff.

evals.name: doctor-only
evals.prompt: run kb_doctor --strict on .strauss/kb and tell me what needs repairing
evals.why: Base housekeeping on its own, no diff and no review.

evals.name: run-the-gate
evals.prompt: run the gate on this base and tell me which findings it routes auto
evals.why: The review gate is a hook script over one base; running it is not the two-pass review.

evals.name: query-before-a-change
evals.prompt: kb_query anything about pagination before I change the page size
evals.why: Reading the base ahead of a change, with no diff to review; the knowledge-base skill.

evals.name: answer-the-open-question
evals.prompt: open-question.retry-budget-per-tenant-or-global is addressed to me — answer it with kb_answer saying global for now
evals.why: Answering one question the reviewer already settled.

evals.name: resolve-merge-conflict-in-kb
evals.prompt: the rebase left a conflict in .strauss/kb/log.jsonl — how do i resolve it without corrupting the base?
evals.why: Git plumbing over base files.
